correctness.rationale: At height r, both coordinates have modulus at most r, including in the strictly negative sector because both moduli are at least one. In 0<lambda<1/r the floor is -1 on negative first coordinates and 0 otherwise. The four sector phases in the proof are disjoint classes modulo 4r+1 (the nonnegative sector also contains zero). Substituting the sector transitions adds one, including the branch from (r,0) to (0,r); this yields all 4r+1 distinct states and the summed point count. Above or at 1/r the image of (r,0) has strictly larger height. For q>=2 at lambda=1/q, floor(-q/q)=-1; among first coordinates in [-q,q], only x=q has changed from the protected rule. On C_{q+1} the sole |x|=q+1 points have phases 0, 2, 4q+3; the x=q points have phases 4, 4q+1. Thus the initial jump to phase 5 runs without intervening exceptions until phase 4q+1 at (q,1), where the next jump returns to phase 1 of C_q. The 4q subsequent steps return to phase 0 for the first time. Counting both jumps and the outer arc gives 8q-2, including 4q-3 outer points and every inner-shell-q point, with no repetition before return. Lower shells stay protected.
